note: Guides are original summaries written for this guide. Seven trophies are marked unconfirmed: their unlock method has not been reliably verified by the community yet.

trophies.guide: The Platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours. There is no shortcut: finish the story, clear the side strands, and grind the collectibles, and this one unlocks itself as the final reward of the whole journey.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play through the opening mission, Gone Fishing. Follow the on-screen prompts, enjoy the introduction to Lucia and Jason, and the trophy unlocks when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Keep playing the main story until Chapter 1 is complete. No side content is needed — just follow the mission markers in order.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. If a mission is not appearing, check the map for the next gold marker — chapters gate on story progress, not on side activities.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3 in full. By now the map has opened up considerably; keep pushing the story missions and the chapter trophy will pop at the final cutscene.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. The late-story missions are longer and tougher, so stock up on armour and ammo before starting each one.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the game. There is only one ending path to the credits here, so play the last mission through to its conclusion and the gold trophy is yours.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks naturally as you progress — just follow the mission marker when it appears.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Bring a fast car and heavy weapons; the escape sequence is the hardest part of the job.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. The mission appears in the story flow, so no extra steps are needed beyond reaching it.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Expect a big set-piece — keep moving between cover and watch for the mission's scripted moments.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. The airport setting means open sightlines; use long-range weapons and stay out of the runway traffic.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It is one of the longer missions, so treat it as a multi-stage job and save your healing items for the final push.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. That means every story mission, stranger strand, activity, collectible set, and stunt — the in-game stats page shows exactly what is still missing, so use it as your checklist.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts across Leonida. Jumps, near-misses, drifts, and airtime all count, and the counter is cumulative across the whole playthrough — so stunt constantly while driving between missions rather than grinding it all at the end.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types at least once: shooting range, drone races, street races, fishing, arcade games, bowling, and the rest. The trophy pops as soon as the ninth distinct activity registers.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each range has multiple weapon drills; learn the recoil pattern of each gun, aim for headshots where the scoring rewards them, and retry individual drills — you do not need to gold them all in one visit.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. Each course has its own layout, so learn the shortcut gates on each map before going for the win.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Street races, off-road events, and boat races all count as long as each race is a distinct event — replays of the same race do not add to the total.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Watch the tension meter and reel in short bursts; Cal's challenges get harder the further into the fishing strand you go.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete any arcade game. Head to an arcade cabinet in Vice City, pick the shortest game on the machine, and play it through to the end screen.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Andy's strand. Andy's missions unlock across the story, so keep checking for his marker between chapters until the last one appears.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Kenton's strand. Kenton's jobs revolve around boats and the waterfront — finish his chain to the end.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Billy's strand. Billy's missions are biker-focused; complete each one as it appears until the finale unlocks.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger markers appear as you explore — there are more than eight strands in total, so pick the ones you enjoy and finish them fully.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Randy's strand. Randy's supply jobs unlock over time; work through them in order.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Tyrone's strand. Finish each of Tyrone's jobs as they appear on the map.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 meditation spots across Leonida. WARNING: this is the only missable trophy in the game — some spots become unavailable after certain story beats, so meditate at each spot the moment you find it and do not leave the set for post-game cleanup.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting strand points you to a rare animal — track it with the hunting scope, approach downwind, and take a clean shot.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete three Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida in shops, hideouts, and landmarks; each set needs every card in it, so use the in-game collection tracker to find which sets are closest to done.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. The WAiNK app marks photo spots across the state — visit each one, frame the shot, and snap it. The counter is cumulative, so chip away at it while exploring.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges range from driving feats to combat goals and are tracked in the pause menu; knock out the easy ones first and the count climbs fast.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a four-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then escape the heat. Grab a fast car together, break line of sight, and hide until the stars clear — the trophy pops once the wanted level is fully gone.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Plan a route through three nearby shops, keep the getaway car close, and do not let the wanted level drop between robberies.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Simply driving a new vehicle type registers it in the collection; check the vehicle log to see which categories are still missing and hunt those down.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies during a single use of Combat Focus. Find a group of enemies, trigger Combat Focus when they are clustered, and chain headshots before the meter runs out.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal a plane from the airport and take off without following the usual routes — the trophy triggers once you are airborne and clear of the runways.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhinos — the tanks that roll in at high wanted levels. Use sticky bombs, heavy weapons, or lure them into tight spots; one destroyed Rhino is enough to pop it.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet, avoid the cameras and guards, and leave before the alarm trips — if anyone spots you, restart the attempt.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape. Vaults are high-risk jobs that need planning: scout the bank, bring a getaway mindset, and escape cleanly after each one — the count is cumulative.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush a truck on a quiet road, crack it open, grab the cash, and lose the cops before the trophy pops.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive, fly, and sail through every named region — the map tracker shows which areas are still unvisited, so mop up the stragglers last.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. Each gang runs its own racket somewhere in Leonida; hit one operation per gang and the trophy unlocks.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact trigger is not yet confirmed by the community — the leading guess is a specific beachfront bar at sunset, so try the Ocean Beach bars and watch for a prompt. Marked unconfirmed until a reliable method is verified.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The method is still unconfirmed — the community suspects a particular showroom and a high-speed exit through the front glass, but no verified route exists yet.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Walk into the alley, start a game, and complete at least one full frame — the trophy pops once you have bowled.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. This one is still unconfirmed — the description hints at a co-op moment with Lucia or Jason, but no verified trigger has been documented yet.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. Unconfirmed: the community suspects it tracks a large number of choices made across the game, but the exact count and trigger remain unverified.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Unconfirmed — the name suggests succeeding on a retry after a failure, but no reliable method has been confirmed.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Unconfirmed — this reads like a secret or easter-egg encounter somewhere in Leonida, but no verified location or trigger is known yet.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Unconfirmed — the description suggests a drive-by melee attack, likely tied to bowling, but the exact method is not verified.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering marked bills through your contacts. Launder bills steadily through the contacts you unlock — the total is cumulative, so keep feeding marked bills into the system as you earn them.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy weapons, clothes, cars, and upgrades normally and the total adds up on its own — the counter is cumulative across every shop in the game.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all eight garage properties. Garages go on sale as you progress; buy each one when it appears on the property market until all eight are yours.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app, snap a photo of a vehicle you own or find, and register it — repeat for ten different vehicles.
trophies.name: On the Spot
